resources.string: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line

EnterSend reads the focused text field and the buttons next to it so that the physical Enter key can press the send button in chat apps. Shift+Enter inserts a new line. In search bars, address bars, password fields, notes and email, Enter works as usual. Nothing leaves your phone: EnterSend has no internet access.
